data.one_liner: Get notified when a Flutter widget is focused or unfocused and react to it.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget wrapper that triggers callbacks when a view or app lifecycle state changes. It lets you detect focus, visibility, foreground/background states, and app lifecycle events.
use_when: You need to pause or resume videos or camera previews when a widget comes into view.
You want to trigger data synchronization when a specific screen or widget is focused.
You need to handle app lifecycle events at the widget level.
avoid_when: You only need global app lifecycle observation without widget-level granularity.
Your project uses a Flutter version below 3.13.0.
strengths: Offers 13 different events including focus, visibility, and app lifecycle changes.
Successor to the unmaintained Focus Detector package with modern AppLifecycleListener support.
Supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires a minimum Dart SDK of 3.1.0 and Flutter 3.13.0+.
Web testing requires setting a specific environment variable (--dart-define=TEST=true).
